annotations.title: Forecast accuracy scorecard (MAPE, WAPE, MASE, bias)

description: Forecast accuracy scorecard (MAPE, WAPE, MASE, bias) — Score a forecast against what actually happened. actual= and forecast= equal-length comma-separated numbers (2-5000). Optional season= lag for the naive benchmark (default 1; 12 for monthly seasonal). Returns MAE, RMSE, MAPE, sMAPE, WAPE, mean error bias and bias %, MASE, Theil U2, tracking signal, R-squared, over/under counts, the 5 worst points, grade EXCELLENT/GOOD/FAIR/POOR/VERY_POOR (by WAPE), bias flag UNBIASED/BIASED_HIGH/BIASED_LOW and whether it beats a naive forecast. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_forecast_accuracy
